marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 15 knots except southwest 25 near the Blow River
tonight. Wind becoming northwest 20 Saturday morning then backing to west 15
early Saturday evening. Scattered showers. Fog patches dissipating Saturday
morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late
Saturday afternoon.<br/>
